FIND IT FROM A PHOTO

Have a photo?
We'll find it.

Drop a photo of a handle, knob, hook or door fitting. An AI describes what it sees (type, finish, size) and we show the closest products in the shop. No photo to hand? Try an example.

Before you upload. Photograph the item only, never people. Your photo is shrunk in your browser, then sent to an AI service (Google Gemini, with OpenRouter as a backup) to describe the item. Fabrication Intelligence does not store it. On Google's free tier, Google may use uploads to improve its products.
